name: reachinbox-scheduler
description: ReachInbox Full-Stack Email Scheduler with BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Nodemailer, Ethereal, Elasticsearch, Google & Slack OAuth

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WORKER,CLIENT" -c "blue,yellow,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
